identity.packageIdentitySource: Explicit final-source Pages build report; each fresh copied-consumer installation is qualified separately.

method.preview: Verified allowlisted public inventory served by scripts/preview-pages.mjs; actual installed consumer output generated earlier, no fresh install inside this probe.
method.dom: Count descendant elements inside each explicitly named host; outerHTML UTF-8 bytes measured separately using TextEncoder. These counts include hidden elements and do not measure retained/peak memory, paint, latency or universal capacity.
method.images: Observe authored /images/ requests and response body bytes. Native lazy scheduling/cache and already-started request cancellation remain browser-owned.
method.input: Scripted browser automation and synthetic pagehide handler probe. No human AT, physical IME/touch/on-screen keyboard, physical device, actual browser zoom, native Safari or deployment qualification.
